identityLock: Final visual world is a bright Vietnamese Vox-style editorial collage: warm off-white lightly wrinkled paper, pale blush pink paper cards, deep mascot pink used only as a small accent, crisp black marker arrows, realistic Vietnamese people and commercial objects cut out cleanly, subtle matte photo grade, soft daylight from upper left, gentle natural shadow, tactile torn deckle edges, playful but precise composition, high mobile readability. No generated words, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, fake social-media interface, neon, purple-blue gradient, dark SaaS UI, green clothing, or clutter. All readable copy, comments, charts, and labels are built later in Remotion.
